selected.name: dragon_green
selected.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite, a SINGLE flat ink emblem on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Jade and Porcelain solitaire art direction: elegant East Asian paper-cut print, bold smooth curved silhouette, very restrained interior negative-space details, crisply readable at 64 pixels. No card, no rectangle, no backing disk, no scene, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no shadow, no glows, no textures outside the emblem. Entire emblem is centered and fully visible within 12% transparent margins. Not a painting, not a photograph, not a 3D render. A friendly dignified jade GREEN dragon head in profile facing right, flowing curved neck, two small antler-like horns, ivory eye and a restrained antique-gold accent on the horns. Mostly dark jade #17634D with restrained emerald accents. Simple print illustration, not a serpent body. Avoid black heavy outlines.
